# 13 - 承認依頼フロー（依頼カード → Yes/No → 結果カード投稿）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 計算結果が閾値超え → Teams に「承認依頼」カード投稿 → ローカルの
# Yes/No ダイアログで担当者判断 → 承認/差戻しの結果カードを投稿。
# Workflows webhook は一方向なので、判断入力は PAD ダイアログで受け、
# 結果を追記カードとして投稿する「疑似承認ループ」の雛形。
# ============================================================
SET ExePath TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\fincalc.exe'''
SET WorkDir TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc'''
SET WebhookUrl TO $'''https://example.webhook.office.com/webhookb2/xxxxx'''


SET Threshold TO 1500000
SET JobName TO $'''源泉徴収 一括計算'''

# CLI を実行し stdout/stderr/exit code を CliOut/CliErr/CliExit へ格納
Scripting.RunDOSCommand.RunDOSCommand DOSCommandOrApplication: $'''%ExePath% tax withholding --amount 10000000''' WorkingDirectory: WorkDir StandardOutput=> CliOut StandardError=> CliErr ExitCode=> CliExit
IF CliExit <> 0 THEN
    # エラーダイアログを出してフロー終了 (IF CliExit <> 0 の中で使う)
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''fincalc エラー''' Message: CliErr Icon: Display.Icon.Warning Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 30
    EXIT
END
# stdout の JSON をカスタムオブジェクトへ変換
Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: CliOut CustomObject=> Result

DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> Now

IF Result.tax <= Threshold THEN
    # 情報ダイアログを表示 (Timeout 秒で自動的に閉じる)
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''承認不要''' Message: $'''税額 %Result.tax% 円は閾値内のため承認依頼を出しません''' Icon: Display.Icon.Information Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 10
    EXIT
END

# --- 1. 承認依頼カードを投稿 ---
SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"[承認依頼] %JobName%","weight":"bolder","size":"medium","color":"warning"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"支払総額","value":"%Result.grossAmount% 円"},{"title":"源泉税額","value":"%Result.tax% 円"},{"title":"手取額","value":"%Result.netPayment% 円"},{"title":"閾値","value":"%Threshold% 円"},{"title":"依頼時刻","value":"%Now%"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"warning","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"閾値超過のため担当者の承認が必要です。続けて結果カードが投稿されます","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
# Teams Webhook へ Adaptive Card JSON を POST (応答は HTTP 202)
Web.InvokeWebService.InvokeWebService Url: WebhookUrl Method: Web.Method.Post Accept: $'''application/json''' ContentType: $'''application/json''' RequestBody: Body EncodeRequestBody: False TrimRequestBody: True ClearCookies: True FailOnErrorStatus: False FollowRedirection: True UserAgent: $'''Mozilla/5.0''' ConnectionTimeout: 30 AcceptUntrustedCertificates: False Response=> WebResponse ResponseHeaders=> WebHeaders StatusCode=> WebStatus

# --- 2. 担当者に Yes/No を聞く ---
Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Title: $'''承認確認''' Message: $'''%JobName% : 税額 %Result.tax% 円（閾値 %Threshold% 円超過）を承認しますか？''' Icon: Display.Icon.Question Buttons: Display.Buttons.YesNo DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button2 IsTopMost: True ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed

# --- 3. 判断結果を追記カードで投稿 ---
DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> Now
IF ButtonPressed = 'Yes' THEN
    SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"[承認] %JobName%","weight":"bolder","size":"medium"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"源泉税額","value":"%Result.tax% 円"},{"title":"承認時刻","value":"%Now%"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"good","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"担当者が承認しました","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
ELSE
    SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"[差戻し] %JobName%","weight":"bolder","size":"medium","color":"attention"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"源泉税額","value":"%Result.tax% 円"},{"title":"差戻し時刻","value":"%Now%"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"attention","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"担当者が差し戻しました。金額を確認してください","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
END

# Teams Webhook へ Adaptive Card JSON を POST (応答は HTTP 202)
Web.InvokeWebService.InvokeWebService Url: WebhookUrl Method: Web.Method.Post Accept: $'''application/json''' ContentType: $'''application/json''' RequestBody: Body EncodeRequestBody: False TrimRequestBody: True ClearCookies: True FailOnErrorStatus: False FollowRedirection: True UserAgent: $'''Mozilla/5.0''' ConnectionTimeout: 30 AcceptUntrustedCertificates: False Response=> WebResponse ResponseHeaders=> WebHeaders StatusCode=> WebStatus

IF (WebStatus < 200) OR (WebStatus > 299) THEN

    EXIT
